The cloudnative-pg GitHub organization owns postgres-containers, whose GOVERNANCE.md at the image revision defers to the CloudNativePG governance policies. activitySupport.notes: PostgreSQL 18 is supported until 2030-11-14, and the versioning page read 2026-11-23 lists 18.7 as the current 18.x minor. 18.7 delivers fixes for 52 PostgreSQL CVEs, none in the CISA KEV catalogue 2026.11.20; the pinned scanners do not match the PGDG postgresql-18 package, so the gate cannot see that class of finding. CNPG rebuilds its operand images weekly. This build was signed 2026-11-12T23:16:14Z (Rekor) and listed at 23:16:17Z, within six months; the 14-day cool-off ends 2026-11-26T23:16:17Z.
